items.title: Antonelli clinched the 2026 Drivers' Championship in Mexico City
items.summary: Third place in the Mexico City Grand Prix was enough for Kimi Antonelli to secure his maiden Drivers' title, regardless of where his rivals finished.
items.why_it_matters: The title is already decided before Las Vegas; do not present the current standings gap as an active championship fight.

items.title: Mercedes clinched the 2026 Constructors' title in São Paulo
items.summary: George Russell finished fourth and Kimi Antonelli fifth in the São Paulo Grand Prix, enough for Mercedes to secure its ninth Constructors' Championship.
items.why_it_matters: Both championship titles are settled. Las Vegas is about race wins and the remaining finishing positions, not title permutations.

sources.label: Formula1.com on the São Paulo race and Mercedes' title

items.title: Stella says further McLaren parts are planned for Las Vegas
items.summary: Stella said cooler track and ambient temperatures helped the MCL40 control tyre temperatures in Brazil, while hot-condition long-run consistency remains work in progress. He said the Interlagos upgrades will be complemented by further parts in Las Vegas as a foundation for 2027; he named no components.
items.why_it_matters: This is a team development plan, not a published FIA submission or a measured performance gain. The Las Vegas FIA listing remains inaccessible, so the component filing status is unverified.

sources.label: Formula1.com on Stella's McLaren development plan
